text:
marta (Customer IT): Hi — running into repeated failures generating/uploading debug bundle from our private collector in eu-central. Collector reports a redaction mismatch and then upload presign returns 403. Customer blocked. request_id=rc:94f1b2e, collector_pid=3129.
jess (Support): Sorry to hear that. Can you paste the collector log lines around the run and the exact curl you used for presign?
marta (Customer IT): Log excerpt: `2024-11-05T09:12:07Z INFO bundlegen: starting run id=run-20241105-09 pid=3129`
`2024-11-05T09:12:12Z ERROR redact: mismatch detected field=ipaddr expected=<REDACTED> observed=192.0.2.45`
`2024-11-05T09:12:12Z ERROR upload: presign request failed status=403 req_id=rc:94f1b2e`
Curl they tried: `curl -v -X POST "https://private-upload.eu.redwood.example/presign" -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -F "manifest=@/tmp/manifest.json"`
alan (SRE): Two quick hypotheses: 1) redaction filter config on the collector differs from the server's expected schema -> manifest checksum/signature mismatch. 2) presign 403 could be KMS or token scope issue.
sanjay (Infra Eng): Can you run collector with DEBUG=collector:upload enabled and re-run the bundle generation for one small file? We need full debug logs including the signed-manifest payload. Example: `DEBUG=collector:upload ./collector --generate-bundle --out /tmp/db.tar.gz`
marta (Customer IT): Re-ran with debug, attached sanitized log snippet (we removed customer IPs before posting). Collector shows `manifest_checksum=sha256:5f2a...` and `signed_manifest=eyJhbGciOiJ...` then `upload presign response: 403 {"error":"Forbidden","code":"UploadNotAllowed"}`
jess (Support): Please also paste the collector's computed Content-MD5 for the bundle. Server validates that against the manifest during handshake.
marta (Customer IT): Content-MD5: `Q2hlY2stVGVzdC0xMjM=` (base64).
collector-bot: Debug bundle created /var/collector/out/debugbundle-20241105.tar.gz size=12MB checksum=sha256:5f2a... md5=507f1f77bcf86cd799439011 (note: bot message is automated).
alan (SRE): The md5 mismatch between base64 and hex could be the issue — server expects base64 MD5 in the manifest header `Content-MD5`. Can you confirm which format your collector writes to manifest?
marta (Customer IT): The collector manifest shows `md5_hex: 507f1f77bcf86cd799439011`. We can change to base64, but why would presign return 403 vs 400?
sanjay (Infra Eng): 403 comes from the upload policy rejecting the signed-manifest when checksum header doesn't match signature verification step. That is by design to avoid partial uploads. To unblock: 1) regenerate manifest with base64 MD5 field `Content-MD5`, 2) re-sign manifest, 3) request new presign.
jess (Support): While you do that, can you also try SFTP fallback? We can provision an ephemeral SFTP target for you to scp the bundle directly — helps us collect the artifact if presign keeps failing.
marta (Customer IT): Yes please. If you can provision SFTP I can upload in the next 30m (we're in CET).
alan (SRE): Provisioning now. Host: sftp-support.eu.redwood.example user: marta_eu expiry: 2h. We'll DM creds via secure channel.
jess (Support): Also please produce a minimal curl repro for presign so we can reproduce in our environment:
```
curl -v -X POST "https://private-upload.eu.redwood.example/presign" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <support-token>" \
  -H "Content-MD5: Q2hlY2stVGVzdC0xMjM=" \
  -F "manifest=@manifest.json"
```
jess (Support): Once you upload to SFTP, send the sftp path and we will pull the bundle and run local verification; we'll try both the current manifest and a normalized version.
marta (Customer IT): Uploading now to sftp-support.eu:redwood/marta_eu/debugbundle-20241105.tar.gz — started at 09:48 CET.
collector-bot: upload progress 30% 09:49
marta (Customer IT): Done. File size 12,345,678 bytes. Path: /home/marta_eu/debugbundle-20241105.tar.gz
alan (SRE): Got it. Running verification. If it's a signature mismatch we'll re-sign on our side and generate a presign URL you can use.
jess (Support): FYI I opened an internal incident ticket INC-20241105-224 with infra; assigning to @alan to lead analysis.
alan (SRE): Quick initial check: manifest checksum matches payload but signed_manifest header missing `kid` claim (key id). Collector omitted KMS key id during sign step -> server cannot validate signature even if checksum ok. Explains 403.
sanjay (Infra Eng): We'll add a quick collector patch to emit `kid` in the signed manifest and produce base64 md5. Patch target in repo: collector/handler/upload.go lines 214-230.
marta (Customer IT): Appreciate the fast turnaround. ETA on patch?
sanjay (Infra Eng): Can cut a 1-line change and build a 0.1.1 debug image in ~45m. If you prefer we can sign the manifest on our side as a temporary workaround.
jess (Support): Plan: 1) we pulled your bundle; 2) infra will either re-sign manifest or provide patched collector build; 3) we will generate a new presign URL and confirm upload end-to-end; 4) share final root-cause notes and collector change.
marta (Customer IT): Sounds good. Thanks — will await instructions. :thumbsup:
alan (SRE): Assigned follow-up. Will post back when presign URL is ready or when patched binary is available.
jess (Support): Closing the customer-facing loop: I'll DM Marta once we have a working presign and confirm upload succeeded.
marta (Customer IT): Thanks all, saved my Friday :)
